note: BH-7235: the retention window of the hub sweep's marker files: state/pr-state-reconcile/alerted-* (one lane-alert per id), state/live-probes/* (a head's probe done and tries markers) and state/lead-review-enqueue/qa-reset-* (a console QA reset per head). Once in 24 h the sweep deletes the ones older than this; the first sweep on a box only counts them (dry run). It protects the hub disk from one file per PR head forever. A PR open longer than the window runs its read-only probes once more, which posts one more App comment. 0 = off: nothing is deleted.
